Change.doc: Change is one step of a plan.

Change.String.doc: String says what the change does, in a few words.

Change.Warning.doc: Warning says what could go wrong, or is "".

CreateEnum.doc: CreateEnum creates a native enum type.

CreateIndex.RunsOnline.doc: RunsOnline reports whether the index builds without blocking writes, which PostgreSQL does not allow in a transaction.

CreateTable.doc: CreateTable creates a table with its columns, primary key, unique constraints, and checks.

Dialect.doc: Dialect is what a database implements to take part in migrations.

Dialect.Canonical.doc: Canonical returns target as the database itself would store it, by creating it in a throwaway form.

Dialect.ColumnType.doc: ColumnType maps a Go type to a column type.

Dialect.Database.doc: Database returns the name of the connected database.

Dialect.EnsureTable.doc: EnsureTable returns statements that create t only if it is missing.

Dialect.Explain.doc: Explain returns what the driver knows about a failure in a script.

Dialect.Guarded.doc: Guarded returns a statement that runs the given scripts only if condition is true, for idempotent exports.

Dialect.Inspect.decl: Inspect(ctx context.Context, q Querier, schemas []string) (*Schema, error)
Dialect.Inspect.doc: Inspect reads the tables of the live database in the given schemas.

Dialect.IsMissingTable.doc: IsMissingTable reports whether err says a table does not exist.

Dialect.Lock.decl:
Lock(
	ctx context.Context,
	conn *sql.Conn,
	name string,
) (release func(context.Context) error, err error)
Dialect.Lock.doc: Lock takes a lock that lasts until the release function runs, so that only one migrator works at a time.

Dialect.MaxIdentifier.doc: MaxIdentifier is the longest allowed name, or 0 for no limit.

Dialect.SameExpression.doc: SameExpression reports whether two stored expressions mean the same, when their text differs.

Dialect.SessionReset.doc: SessionReset returns a statement that undoes session settings a script changed, or "".

Dialect.Split.doc: Split separates a script into statements.

Dialect.Statements.doc: Statements returns the SQL for one change, without terminators.

Dialect.Summary.doc: Summary describes the connected database for a person.

Dialect.Wipe.doc: Wipe returns statements that remove everything in the given schemas.

Dialect.Zero.doc: Zero returns the literal that fills a new NOT NULL column in existing rows, or "" if the type has no obvious one.

Diff.doc: Diff returns the plan from from to to.

DropConstraint.doc: DropConstraint removes a unique or check constraint.

DropIndex.RunsOnline.doc: RunsOnline reports whether the index goes without blocking writes.

DropTable.Cascade.doc: remove what depends on it too

DropTable.IfExists.doc: no error if it is missing

Enum.doc: Enum is a native enum type.

ErrNewerFormat.decl: var ErrNewerFormat = errors.New("ant: snapshot was written by a newer version of ant")
ErrNewerFormat.doc: ErrNewerFormat reports a snapshot written by a newer version of ant.

ErrUnsupported.decl: var ErrUnsupported = errors.New("ant: dialect does not support migrations")
ErrUnsupported.doc: ErrUnsupported reports a dialect with no migration support.

Facets.doc: Facets are the sizes configured on a column.

Facets.Fixed.doc: Length is exact, not a limit

Failure.doc: Failure is what a driver reports beyond its error message.

Failure.Detail.doc: the database's explanation, such as the duplicated value

Failure.Offset.doc: where in the script it happened, in characters from 1, or 0

ForeignKey.doc: ForeignKey is a foreign key constraint.

ForeignKey.OnDelete.doc: SQL action; empty means NO ACTION

ForeignKeyName.decl: func ForeignKeyName(d Dialect, table string, columns ...string) string
ForeignKeyName.doc: ForeignKeyName returns the default name of a foreign key.

Format.doc: Format is the version of the snapshot file format.

Generated.decl: const Generated = "-- Generated by ant from your models. This is plain SQL: review it, and edit it if you need to."
Generated.doc: Generated is the first line of a generated migration.

Hint.doc: Hint is a possible rename that a diff saw but cannot be sure of.

Hint.Change.doc: Change returns the rename this hint suggests.

Hint.Column.doc: Column is empty when the hint is about the table itself.

Hint.Flag.doc: Flag returns the value for a rename in Diff that takes up this hint.

Hint.String.doc: String says what was seen, for a person to judge.

Index.Concurrent.doc: Concurrent builds the index without blocking writes, on an existing table.

IndexName.decl: func IndexName(d Dialect, table string, columns ...string) string
IndexName.doc: IndexName returns the default name of an index.

IndexPart.doc: IndexPart is one indexed column or expression.

Key.doc: Key is a primary key or unique constraint.

NoTransaction.doc: NoTransaction is the directive that makes a migration run outside a transaction.

Of.doc: Of returns d's migration support, or ErrUnsupported.

Online.doc: Online is implemented by changes that cannot run in a transaction.

Partition.doc: Partition says how a table is split into partitions.

Plan.doc: Plan is the ordered list of changes from one schema to another.

Plan.Empty.doc: Empty reports whether there is nothing to do.

Plan.Online.doc: Online reports whether any change must run outside a transaction.

Plan.Warnings.doc: Warnings returns the warnings of every change.

PrimaryKeyName.decl: func PrimaryKeyName(d Dialect, table string) string
PrimaryKeyName.doc: PrimaryKeyName returns the default name of a table's primary key.

Querier.doc: Querier runs read queries, on a pool, a connection, or a transaction.

Querier.QueryContext.decl: QueryContext(ctx context.Context, query string, args ...any) (*sql.Rows, error)

Ref.String.doc: String returns the name as schema.table, or table in the default schema.

RemoveEnumValue.doc: RemoveEnumValue reports a value gone from an enum, which needs a person: rows may hold it, and PostgreSQL cannot drop one.

Schema.doc: Schema is the full structure of a database.

Schema.Encode.doc: Encode returns the snapshot file for s.

Schema.Enum.doc: Enum returns the enum called name, or nil.

Schema.Latest.doc: Latest is the last migration this schema reflects.

Schema.Sequence.doc: Sequence returns the sequence called name, or nil.

Schema.Sort.doc: Sort puts tables and their objects in a stable order, so that the snapshot of an unchanged model is byte for byte the same.

Schema.Table.doc: Table returns the table called ref, or nil.

Schema.Unmanaged.doc: Unmanaged tables exist, but migrations leave them alone.

Script.doc: Script writes a plan as a SQL file, with warnings as comments above the statements they concern.

Statements.doc: Statements returns the SQL of a plan, without comments.

Summary.doc: Summary is a short description of a live database.

Table.Column.doc: Column returns the column called name, or nil.

TableSummary.doc: TableSummary is one table in a Summary.

Typed.doc: Typed is implemented by Go types that know their column type, such as ant.JSON.

UniqueName.decl: func UniqueName(d Dialect, table string, columns ...string) string
UniqueName.doc: UniqueName returns the default name of a unique constraint.

ErrNoKeys.doc: Errors from reading and writing values.

ErrUnknownKey.decl: var ErrUnknownKey = errors.New("ant: value was encrypted with an unknown key")
ErrUnknownKey.doc: Errors from reading and writing values.

NeedsRotation.doc: NeedsRotation reports whether a stored value used a key other than the active one.

New.doc: New returns a Value holding v.

SetKeys.decl: func SetKeys(active string, keys map[string][]byte) error
SetKeys.doc: SetKeys sets the keys, each 32 bytes, and which one new writes use.

Value.doc: Value holds a Go value that is encrypted in the database.

Value.MarshalJSON.doc: MarshalJSON hides the value, so that returning a model from an API cannot leak it.

Value.String.doc: String hides the value, so that a log line or a %v cannot leak it.

Dialect.doc: Dialect is the SQLite dialect, for version 3.39 or later.
Dialect is the SQL Server dialect, for version 2019 or later.

All.decl: func All[V any](rules ...func(V) error) func(V) error
All.doc: All runs rules in order, stopping at the first failure.

Email.doc: Email rejects a string that is not an email address.

ErrRequired.doc: ErrRequired reports a zero value in a required field.

Matches.doc: Matches rejects a string that does not match pattern.

MaxLength.doc: MaxLength rejects a string with more characters than n.

MinLength.doc: MinLength rejects a string with fewer characters than n.

OneOf.doc: OneOf rejects a value not in the list.

Range.decl: func Range[V cmp.Ordered](low, high V) func(V) error
Range.doc: Range rejects a value outside low and high, inclusive.
